summons.name: Summons (Family Law)
summons.notes: Contains Standard Family Law Restraining Orders (ATROs)

disclosureService.name: Declaration Regarding Service of Declaration of Disclosure

uccjea.name: Declaration Under Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act (UCCJEA)

defaultDeclaration.name: Declaration for Default or Uncontested Dissolution

maritalStandard.name: Spousal or Partner Support Declaration Attachment

residencyRequirements.description: Petitioner must be a California resident for at least 6 months and a county resident for at least 3 months before filing.
residencyRequirements.sameSexMarriageException: Same-sex couples married in California but living in a non-recognition state may file in the county where they were married.

waitingPeriod.description: California has a mandatory 6-month waiting period. No divorce can be finalized until 6 months after Respondent is served. There are NO exceptions.

noFault.name: Irreconcilable Differences
noFault.description: Irreconcilable differences which have caused the irremediable breakdown of the marriage

fault.name: Incurable Insanity
fault.description: Permanent legal incapacity to make decisions
fault.notes: Requires medical proof and competent medical testimony

automaticRestrainingOrders.description: Standard Family Law Restraining Orders (ATROs) automatically apply when FL-110 Summons is served
restrictions: Cannot remove minor children from state without prior written consent or court order
Cannot transfer, encumber, conceal, or dispose of property without consent or court order
Cannot cancel, modify, or change insurance coverage without consent or court order
Cannot create non-probate transfer of property without consent or court order

financialDisclosure.description: California requires mandatory financial disclosure. Both parties must exchange preliminary declarations of disclosure.

font.family: Times New Roman or similar proportionally spaced font

formattingRequirements.notes: Per California Rules of Court, Rules 2.100-2.119

legalCitations.description: Grounds for dissolution or legal separation

filingFees.notes: Varies by county. Fee waiver (FW-001) available for qualifying individuals.

calculationFactors: Net disposable income of both parents
Percentage of time each parent has primary physical custody

factors: Standard of living during the marriage
Supported party's ability to maintain standard of living
Needs and obligations of each party
Goal of self-sufficiency within reasonable time

duration.shortMarriage: Half the length of marriage (general guideline for marriages under 10 years)
duration.longMarriage: Court retains jurisdiction indefinitely for marriages of 10+ years

propertyDivision.description: California is a community property state. All property acquired during marriage is presumed community property and divided equally.
propertyDivision.dateOfSeparation: Critical date that determines when community property accumulation ends
